research_title: Pattern A FAST Strategy Finalization / Candidate Selection v0.1

investment_mandate.philosophy: Invest only in structurally confirmed trend beginnings. Intentionally forego bottom bounces and uncertain structures to prevent catastrophic drawdowns.

HOLD_A.name: NO_PRE_PROGRESSED_PROTECTION
HOLD_A.description: Unconditional hold until PROGRESSED or cutoff without time or price stop.

HOLD_B.name: PRE_PROGRESSED_CATASTROPHIC_LOSS_GUARD
HOLD_B.description: Signal loss protection exit if completed daily close <= -15% from entry price before PROGRESSED, execute next local open.

E0.name: EXIT3_ONLY
E0.description: Exit 3 structural backstop only upon PROGRESSED departure to valid stage. No Exit 4 or Coverage Activation.

E1.name: EXIT3_PLUS_NORMAL_EXIT4
E1.description: Exit 3 + Normal Exit 4 (15.0pt drawdown) on direct EARLY_TREND to PROGRESSED handoff. Coverage Hole open at cutoff.

E2.name: EXIT3_PLUS_EXIT4_PLUS_COVERAGE
E2.description: Exit 3 + Normal Exit 4 + Coverage Activated Exit 4 on first observed PROGRESSED monthly snapshot.

invariants: Strictly local cache data up to 2026-08-14 (zero fresh data queries).
Zero threshold sweeps (HOLD_B is strictly -15%, Exit 4 is strictly 15.0pt).
No post-hoc re-inclusion of WEAK, BASE, UNAVAILABLE, or PROGRESSED entries.
Selection of a single final strategy candidate (PATTERN_A_FAST_FINAL_STRATEGY_V01).
